class DstaskApp:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.stdout_is_tty = sys.stdout.isatty() or bool(os.getenv("DSTASK_FAKE_PTY"))
        self.stdin_is_tty = sys.stdin.isatty() and sys.stdout.isatty()
        self.repo_path = self._repo_path()

    def _repo_path(self) -> Path:
        env_path = os.getenv("DSTASK_GIT_REPO")
        if env_path:
            return Path(env_path).expanduser()
        home = Path(os.path.expanduser("~"))
        return home / ".dstask"

    def run(self, argv: list[str]) -> int:
        raw_args = list(argv)
        ignore_context = False
        args: list[str] = []
        for arg in raw_args:
            if arg == "--":
                ignore_context = True
            else:
                args.append(arg)

        cmd, pre_tokens, post_tokens = self._parse_command(args)

        if cmd == "help":
            self._print_help(post_tokens)
            return 0
        if cmd == "version":
            self._write("Version: Unknown\nGit commit: Unknown\nBuild date: Unknown\n")
            return 0
        if cmd == "bash-completion":
            self._write(BASH_COMPLETION)
            return 0
        if cmd == "zsh-completion":
            self._write(ZSH_COMPLETION)
            return 0
        if cmd == "fish-completion":
            self._write(FISH_COMPLETION)
            return 0
        if cmd == "_completions":
            return self._cmd_completions()

        if cmd in REPO_COMMANDS and not self.ensure_repo():
            return 1

        if cmd == "context":
            return self._cmd_context(pre_tokens + post_tokens)
        if cmd == "git":
            return self._cmd_git(pre_tokens + post_tokens)
        if cmd == "sync":
            return self._cmd_sync()
        if cmd == "undo":
            return self._cmd_undo(pre_tokens + post_tokens)

        tasks = self.load_tasks()
        context_string = self.current_context()
        context_query = parse_query(context_string.split()) if context_string and not ignore_context else None

        if cmd == "add":
            return self._cmd_add(tasks, post_tokens + pre_tokens, context_string, ignore_context)
        if cmd == "log":
            return self._cmd_log(tasks, post_tokens + pre_tokens, context_string, ignore_context)
        if cmd == "template":
            return self._cmd_template(tasks, pre_tokens + post_tokens, context_string, ignore_context)
        if cmd == "start":
            return self._cmd_start(tasks, pre_tokens + post_tokens, context_string, ignore_context, context_query)
        if cmd == "stop":
            return self._cmd_transition(tasks, pre_tokens + post_tokens, context_query, ignore_context, "stop")
        if cmd == "done":
            return self._cmd_done(tasks, pre_tokens + post_tokens, context_query, ignore_context)
        if cmd == "modify":
            return self._cmd_modify(tasks, pre_tokens + post_tokens, context_query, ignore_context)
        if cmd == "remove":
            return self._cmd_remove(tasks, pre_tokens + post_tokens, context_query, ignore_context)
        if cmd == "note":
            return self._cmd_note(tasks, pre_tokens + post_tokens, context_query, ignore_context)
        if cmd == "edit":
            return self._cmd_edit(tasks, pre_tokens + post_tokens, context_query, ignore_context)
        if cmd == "open":
            return self._cmd_open(tasks, pre_tokens + post_tokens, context_query, ignore_context)
        if cmd == "show-projects":
            return self._cmd_show_projects(tasks, pre_tokens + post_tokens, context_query, ignore_context)
        if cmd == "show-tags":
            return self._cmd_show_tags(tasks, pre_tokens + post_tokens, context_query, ignore_context)
        if cmd == "show-unorganised":
            return self._cmd_show_unorganised(tasks)
        if cmd in {"show-active", "show-paused", "show-open", "show-resolved", "show-templates", "next"}:
            return self._cmd_show(tasks, cmd, pre_tokens + post_tokens, context_query, ignore_context)

        return self._cmd_show(tasks, "next", pre_tokens + post_tokens, context_query, ignore_context)

    def _parse_command(self, args: list[str]) -> tuple[str, list[str], list[str]]:
        for index, token in enumerate(args):
            normalized = ALIASES.get(token, token)
            if normalized in KNOWN_COMMANDS:
                return normalized, args[:index], args[index + 1 :]
        return "next", [], args

    def ensure_repo(self) -> bool:
        if self._repo_exists():
            return True

        repo_text = str(self.repo_path)
        if self.stdin_is_tty:
            self._write(f"Could not find dstask repository at {repo_text} -- create? [y/n] ", newline=False)
            answer = sys.stdin.readline().strip().lower()
            if answer not in {"y", "yes"}:
                self._error("Aborted.")
                return False

        if not self._create_repo():
            self._error("Failed to create directory in git repository")
            return False
        return True

    def _repo_exists(self) -> bool:
        return self.repo_path.is_dir() and (self.repo_path / ".git").exists()

    def _create_repo(self) -> bool:
        try:
            if self.repo_path.exists():
                if not self.repo_path.is_dir():
                    return False
            else:
                self.repo_path.mkdir()
        except OSError:
            return False

        result = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(self.repo_path), "init"], check=False)
        if result.returncode != 0:
            return False
        self._write("")
        self._write("Add a remote repository with:")
        self._write("")
        self._write("\tdstask git remote add origin <repo>")
        self._write("")
        return True

    def load_tasks(self) -> list[Task]:
        tasks: list[Task] = []
        for status, directory_name in STATUS_DIRS.items():
            directory = self.repo_path / directory_name
            if not directory.exists():
                continue
            for path in sorted(directory.glob("*.yml")):
                try:
                    data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                except Exception:
                    continue
                tasks.append(
                    Task(
                        uuid=data.get("uuid", path.stem),
                        status=status,
                        summary=data.get("summary", ""),
                        notes=data.get("notes", ""),
                        tags=list(data.get("tags", [])),
                        project=data.get("project", ""),
                        priority=data.get("priority", "P2"),
                        created=data.get("created", ZERO_TIME),
                        resolved=data.get("resolved", ZERO_TIME),
                        due=data.get("due", ZERO_TIME),
                        id=int(data.get("id", 0) or 0),
                    )
                )
        return tasks

    def current_context(self) -> str:
        env = os.getenv("DSTASK_CONTEXT")
        if env is not None:
            return env.strip()
        path = self.repo_path / ".context"
        if not path.exists():
            return ""
        return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()

    def set_context(self, value: str) -> None:
        path = self.repo_path / ".context"
        if value:
            path.write_text(value + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        elif path.exists():
            path.unlink()

    def write_task(self, task: Task, previous_status: str | None = None) -> None:
        old_path = None
        if previous_status is not None:
            old_path = self.task_path(previous_status, task.uuid)
        new_path = self.task_path(task.status, task.uuid)
        new_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        if old_path is not None and old_path != new_path and old_path.exists():
            old_path.rename(new_path)
        payload = {
            "uuid": task.uuid,
            "id": task.id,
            "summary": task.summary,
            "notes": task.notes,
            "tags": task.tags,
            "project": task.project,
            "priority": task.priority,
            "created": task.created,
            "resolved": task.resolved,
            "due": task.due,
        }
        new_path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

    def delete_task(self, task: Task) -> None:
        path = self.task_path(task.status, task.uuid)
        if path.exists():
            path.unlink()

    def task_path(self, status: str, task_uuid: str) -> Path:
        return self.repo_path / STATUS_DIRS[status] / f"{task_uuid}.yml"

    def next_id(self, tasks: Iterable[Task]) -> int:
        used = {task.id for task in tasks if task.status in NON_RESOLVED_STATUSES and task.id > 0}
        next_id = 1
        while next_id in used:
            next_id += 1
        return next_id

    def git_commit(self, message: str) -> int:
        add_result = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(self.repo_path), "add", "-A"], check=False)
        if add_result.returncode != 0:
            return add_result.returncode
        result = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(self.repo_path), "commit", "-m", message], check=False)
        if result.returncode != 0:
            self._error(f"error: failed to commit changes: exit status {result.returncode}")
        return result.returncode

    def _cmd_help(self, topic_tokens: list[str]) -> int:
        if topic_tokens:
            topic = ALIASES.get(topic_tokens[0], topic_tokens[0])
            text = HELP_TEXTS.get(topic)
            if text is not None:
                self._write(text)
                return 0
        self._write(GENERAL_HELP)
        return 0

    def _print_help(self, topic_tokens: list[str]) -> None:
        self._cmd_help(topic_tokens)

    def _cmd_completions(self) -> int:
        lines = list(COMMAND_COMPLETIONS)
        lines.extend(PRIORITIES)
        if self._repo_exists():
            tasks = self.load_tasks()
            seen_projects: set[str] = set()
            seen_tags: set[str] = set()
            for task in sort_non_resolved(tasks):
                if task.project and task.project not in seen_projects:
                    seen_projects.add(task.project)
            for project in sorted(seen_projects):
                lines.append(f"project:{project}")
                lines.append(f"-project:{project}")
            for task in sort_non_resolved(tasks):
                for tag in task.tags:
                    if tag not in seen_tags:
                        seen_tags.add(tag)
                        lines.append(f"+{tag}")
                        lines.append(f"-{tag}")
        self._write("\n".join(lines) + ("\n" if lines else ""))
        return 0

    def _cmd_context(self, tokens: list[str]) -> int:
        if not tokens:
            value = self.current_context()
            if value:
                self._write(value)
            return 0
        value = " ".join(tokens).strip()
        if value in {"none", "--"}:
            self.set_context("")
        else:
            self.set_context(value)
        return 0

    def _cmd_git(self, tokens: list[str]) -> int:
        return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(self.repo_path), *tokens], check=False).returncode

    def _cmd_sync(self) -> int:
        pull = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(self.repo_path), "pull"], check=False)
        if pull.returncode != 0:
            return pull.returncode
        push = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(self.repo_path), "push"], check=False)
        return push.returncode

    def _cmd_undo(self, tokens: list[str]) -> int:
        count = 1
        if tokens and tokens[0].isdigit():
            count = max(1, int(tokens[0]))
        rc = 0
        for _ in range(count):
            result = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(self.repo_path), "revert", "--no-edit", "HEAD"], check=False)
            rc = result.returncode
            if rc != 0:
                break
        return rc

    def _cmd_add(self, tasks: list[Task], tokens: list[str], context_string: str, ignore_context: bool) -> int:
        spec = parse_task_spec(tokens)
        template_task = self._template_task(tasks, spec.template_id)
        task = build_task_from_spec(tasks, spec, template_task, "pending", context_string if not ignore_context else "")
        self._write_active_context(context_string, ignore_context)
        self.write_task(task)
        self._write("")
        self._write(f"Added {task.id}: {task.summary}")
        return self.git_commit(f"Added {task.id}: {task.summary}")

    def _cmd_log(self, tasks: list[Task], tokens: list[str], context_string: str, ignore_context: bool) -> int:
        spec = parse_task_spec(tokens)
        template_task = self._template_task(tasks, spec.template_id)
        task = build_task_from_spec(tasks, spec, template_task, "resolved", context_string if not ignore_context else "")
        now = now_rfc3339nano()
        task.created = now
        task.resolved = now
        task.id = 0
        self._write_active_context(context_string, ignore_context)
        self.write_task(task)
        self._write("")
        self._write(f"Logged {task.summary}")
        return self.git_commit(f"Logged {task.summary}")

    def _cmd_template(self, tasks: list[Task], tokens: list[str], context_string: str, ignore_context: bool) -> int:
        source_id, remainder = extract_first_id(tokens)
        template_task = self._select_single(tasks, [source_id], QuerySpec([], [], None, None, None, None, []), None, False, NON_RESOLVED_STATUSES + ("resolved",)) if source_id is not None else None
        spec = parse_task_spec(remainder)
        task = build_task_from_spec(tasks, spec, template_task, "template", context_string if not ignore_context else "")
        self._write_active_context(context_string, ignore_context)
        self.write_task(task)
        self._write("")
        self._write(f"Created Template {task.id}: {task.summary}")
        return self.git_commit(f"Created Template {task.id}: {task.summary}")

    def _cmd_start(
        self,
        tasks: list[Task],
        tokens: list[str],
        context_string: str,
        ignore_context: bool,
        context_query: QuerySpec | None,
    ) -> int:
        ids, remainder = extract_ids(tokens)
        if not ids:
            spec = parse_task_spec(remainder)
            template_task = self._template_task(tasks, spec.template_id)
            task = build_task_from_spec(tasks, spec, template_task, "active", context_string if not ignore_context else "")
            self._write_active_context(context_string, ignore_context)
            self.write_task(task)
            self._write("")
            self._write(f"Added and started {task.id}: {task.summary}")
            return self.git_commit(f"Added and started {task.id}: {task.summary}")

        selected = self.select_tasks(tasks, ids, QuerySpec([], [], None, None, None, None, []), context_query, ignore_context, OPEN_STATUSES)
        if not selected:
            return self.no_matches()
        for task in selected:
            if task.status == "active":
                self._error("invalid state transition: active -> active")
                return 1
            if task.status not in {"pending", "paused"}:
                self._error(f"invalid state transition: {task.status} -> active")
                return 1
        for task in selected:
            old_status = task.status
            task.status = "active"
            self.write_task(task, previous_status=old_status)
        task = selected[0]
        self._write("")
        self._write(f"Started {task.id}: {task.summary}")
        message = f"Started {task.id}: {task.summary}" if len(selected) == 1 else f"Started {len(selected)} tasks"
        return self.git_commit(message)

    def _cmd_transition(
        self,
        tasks: list[Task],
        tokens: list[str],
        context_query: QuerySpec | None,
        ignore_context: bool,
        transition: str,
    ) -> int:
        ids, remainder = extract_ids(tokens)
        query = parse_query(remainder)
        selected = self.select_tasks(tasks, ids, query, context_query, ignore_context, OPEN_STATUSES)
        if not selected:
            return self.no_matches()
        if transition == "stop":
            target_status = "paused"
            verb = "Stopped"
            valid_from = {"active"}
        else:
            raise AssertionError("unsupported transition")
        for task in selected:
            if task.status not in valid_from:
                self._error(f"invalid state transition: {task.status} -> {target_status}")
                return 1
        for task in selected:
            old_status = task.status
            task.status = target_status
            self.write_task(task, previous_status=old_status)
        task = selected[0]
        self._write("")
        self._write(f"{verb} {task.id}: {task.summary}")
        message = f"{verb} {task.id}: {task.summary}" if len(selected) == 1 else f"{verb} {len(selected)} tasks"
        return self.git_commit(message)

    def _cmd_done(
        self,
        tasks: list[Task],
        tokens: list[str],
        context_query: QuerySpec | None,
        ignore_context: bool,
    ) -> int:
        ids, remainder = extract_ids(tokens)
        note = " ".join(remainder).strip()
        selected = self.select_tasks(tasks, ids, QuerySpec([], [], None, None, None, None, []), context_query, ignore_context, OPEN_STATUSES)
        if not selected:
            return self.no_matches()
        for task in selected:
            display_id = task.id
            old_status = task.status
            task.status = "resolved"
            task.id = 0
            task.resolved = now_rfc3339nano()
            if note:
                task.notes += "\n" + note
            self.write_task(task, previous_status=old_status)
        task = selected[0]
        display_id = ids[0] if ids else display_id
        self._write("")
        self._write(f"Resolved {display_id}: {task.summary}")
        message = f"Resolved {display_id}: {task.summary}" if len(selected) == 1 else f"Resolved {len(selected)} tasks"
        return self.git_commit(message)

    def _cmd_modify(
        self,
        tasks: list[Task],
        tokens: list[str],
        context_query: QuerySpec | None,
        ignore_context: bool,
    ) -> int:
        ids, remainder = extract_ids(tokens)
        spec = parse_modify_spec(remainder)
        if ids:
            selected = self.select_tasks(tasks, ids, QuerySpec([], [], None, None, None, None, []), context_query, ignore_context, OPEN_STATUSES)
        else:
            selected = self.select_tasks(tasks, [], QuerySpec([], [], None, None, None, None, []), context_query, ignore_context, OPEN_STATUSES)
            if selected and self.stdin_is_tty:
                self._write(f"Modify {len(selected)} tasks? [y/n] ", newline=False)
                if sys.stdin.readline().strip().lower() not in {"y", "yes"}:
                    self._error("Aborted.")
                    return 1
        if not selected:
            return self.no_matches()
        for task in selected:
            task.tags = apply_tag_changes(task.tags, spec.add_tags, spec.remove_tags)
            if spec.clear_project:
                task.project = ""
            elif spec.project is not None:
                task.project = spec.project
            if spec.priority is not None:
                task.priority = spec.priority
            if spec.clear_due:
                task.due = ZERO_TIME
            elif spec.due is not None:
                task.due = spec.due
            self.write_task(task)
        task = selected[0]
        self._write("")
        self._write(f"Modified {task.id}: {task.summary}")
        message = f"Modified {task.id}: {task.summary}" if len(selected) == 1 else f"Modified {len(selected)} tasks"
        return self.git_commit(message)

    def _cmd_remove(
        self,
        tasks: list[Task],
        tokens: list[str],
        context_query: QuerySpec | None,
        ignore_context: bool,
    ) -> int:
        ids, remainder = extract_ids(tokens)
        query = parse_query(remainder)
        selected = self.select_tasks(tasks, ids, query, context_query, ignore_context, OPEN_STATUSES + ("template", "resolved"))
        if not selected:
            return self.no_matches()
        for task in selected:
            prefix = task.id if task.id > 0 else 0
            self._write(f"{prefix}: {task.summary}")
        self._write("")
        for task in selected:
            self.delete_task(task)
        task = selected[0]
        prefix = task.id if task.id > 0 else 0
        self._write(f"Removed: {prefix}: {task.summary}")
        message = f"Removed: {prefix}: {task.summary}" if len(selected) == 1 else f"Removed {len(selected)} tasks"
        return self.git_commit(message)

    def _cmd_note(
        self,
        tasks: list[Task],
        tokens: list[str],
        context_query: QuerySpec | None,
        ignore_context: bool,
    ) -> int:
        ids, remainder = extract_ids(tokens)
        selected = self.select_tasks(tasks, ids, QuerySpec([], [], None, None, None, None, []), context_query, ignore_context, OPEN_STATUSES + ("template",))
        if not selected:
            return self.no_matches()
        task = selected[0]
        if remainder:
            task.notes += "\n" + " ".join(remainder).strip()
            self.write_task(task)
            return self.git_commit(f"Updated note for {task.id}: {task.summary}")
        editor = os.getenv("EDITOR") or os.getenv("VISUAL")
        if not editor:
            return 0
        path = self.task_path(task.status, task.uuid)
        subprocess.run([editor, str(path)], check=False)
        return 0

    def _cmd_edit(
        self,
        tasks: list[Task],
        tokens: list[str],
        context_query: QuerySpec | None,
        ignore_context: bool,
    ) -> int:
        ids, _ = extract_ids(tokens)
        selected = self.select_tasks(tasks, ids, QuerySpec([], [], None, None, None, None, []), context_query, ignore_context, OPEN_STATUSES + ("template",))
        if not selected:
            return self.no_matches()
        editor = os.getenv("EDITOR") or os.getenv("VISUAL")
        if not editor:
            return 0
        task = selected[0]
        tmp_path = self.repo_path / ".edit-task.tmp"
        tmp_path.write_text(task.summary + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        subprocess.run([editor, str(tmp_path)], check=False)
        new_summary = tmp_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
        if new_summary:
            task.summary = new_summary
            self.write_task(task)
            rc = self.git_commit(f"Edited {task.id}: {task.summary}")
        else:
            rc = 0
        if tmp_path.exists():
            tmp_path.unlink()
        return rc

    def _cmd_open(
        self,
        tasks: list[Task],
        tokens: list[str],
        context_query: QuerySpec | None,
        ignore_context: bool,
    ) -> int:
        ids, remainder = extract_ids(tokens)
        query = parse_query(remainder)
        selected = self.select_tasks(tasks, ids, query, context_query, ignore_context, OPEN_STATUSES + ("template",))
        if not selected:
            return self.no_matches()
        urls: list[str] = []
        for task in selected:
            urls.extend(URL_RE.findall(task.summary))
            urls.extend(URL_RE.findall(task.notes))
        opener = shutil.which("xdg-open") or shutil.which("open")
        if opener:
            for url in urls:
                subprocess.Popen([opener, url], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        else:
            for url in urls:
                webbrowser.open(url)
        return 0

    def _cmd_show_projects(
        self,
        tasks: list[Task],
        tokens: list[str],
        context_query: QuerySpec | None,
        ignore_context: bool,
    ) -> int:
        ids, remainder = extract_ids(tokens)
        query = parse_query(remainder)
        selected = self.select_tasks(tasks, ids, query, context_query, ignore_context, OPEN_STATUSES + ("resolved",))
        projects: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
        for task in selected:
            if not task.project:
                continue
            entry = projects.setdefault(
                task.project,
                {
                    "name": task.project,
                    "taskCount": 0,
                    "resolvedCount": 0,
                    "active": False,
                    "created": task.created,
                    "resolved": ZERO_TIME,
                    "priority": "P3",
                },
            )
            entry["taskCount"] = int(entry["taskCount"]) + 1
            if task.status == "resolved":
                entry["resolvedCount"] = int(entry["resolvedCount"]) + 1
                if entry["resolved"] == ZERO_TIME or ts_key(task.resolved) > ts_key(str(entry["resolved"])):
                    entry["resolved"] = task.resolved
            else:
                if PRIORITY_ORDER.get(task.priority, 2) < PRIORITY_ORDER.get(str(entry["priority"]), 3):
                    entry["priority"] = task.priority
                if task.status == "active":
                    entry["active"] = True
            if ts_key(task.created) < ts_key(str(entry["created"])):
                entry["created"] = task.created
        ordered = [projects[name] for name in sorted(projects)]
        if self.stdout_is_tty:
            if not ordered:
                return self.no_matches()
            header = "\x1b[4;38;5;250;48;5;232mName     Progress  Created       \x1b[0m"
            self._write(header)
            for index, entry in enumerate(ordered):
                bg = "233" if index % 2 == 0 else "232"
                progress = f"{entry['resolvedCount']}/{entry['taskCount']}"
                created = human_project_created(str(entry["created"]))
                self._write(f"\x1b[0;38;5;250;48;5;{bg}m{entry['name']:<8}{progress:<10}{created}\x1b[0m")
            return 0
        self._write(json.dumps(ordered, indent=2) + "\n")
        return 0

    def _cmd_show_tags(
        self,
        tasks: list[Task],
        tokens: list[str],
        context_query: QuerySpec | None,
        ignore_context: bool,
    ) -> int:
        ids, remainder = extract_ids(tokens)
        query = parse_query(remainder)
        selected = self.select_tasks(tasks, ids, query, context_query, ignore_context, NON_RESOLVED_STATUSES)
        seen: set[str] = set()
        lines: list[str] = []
        for task in sort_non_resolved(selected):
            for tag in task.tags:
                if tag not in seen:
                    seen.add(tag)
                    lines.append(tag)
        if lines:
            self._write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
        return 0

    def _cmd_show_unorganised(self, tasks: list[Task]) -> int:
        selected = [task for task in sort_non_resolved(tasks) if task.status in OPEN_STATUSES and not task.tags and not task.project]
        if self.stdout_is_tty:
            if not selected:
                return self.no_matches()
            return self.render_task_listing(selected, "show-open", None, True)
        self._write(json.dumps([task_json(task) for task in selected], indent=2) + "\n")
        return 0

    def _cmd_show(
        self,
        tasks: list[Task],
        cmd: str,
        tokens: list[str],
        context_query: QuerySpec | None,
        ignore_context: bool,
    ) -> int:
        ids, remainder = extract_ids(tokens)
        query = parse_query(remainder)
        if cmd == "show-active":
            statuses = ("active",)
        elif cmd == "show-paused":
            statuses = ("paused",)
        elif cmd == "show-resolved":
            statuses = ("resolved",)
        elif cmd == "show-templates":
            statuses = ("template",)
        else:
            statuses = OPEN_STATUSES
        selected = self.select_tasks(tasks, ids, query, context_query, ignore_context, statuses)
        if cmd == "show-resolved":
            selected = sort_resolved(selected)
        elif cmd == "show-templates":
            selected = sort_non_resolved(selected)
        else:
            selected = sort_non_resolved(selected)

        if not self.stdout_is_tty:
            self._write(json.dumps([task_json(task) for task in selected], indent=2) + "\n")
            return 0

        if not selected:
            if cmd in {"next", "show-open"}:
                self._write("No tasks found. Run `dstask help` for instructions.")
                return 0
            return self.no_matches()

        context_string = self.current_context()
        if context_string and not ignore_context:
            self._write(f"{COLOR_YELLOW}Active context: {context_string}{COLOR_RESET}")
        return self.render_task_listing(selected, cmd, context_query, ignore_context)

    def render_task_listing(
        self,
        selected: list[Task],
        cmd: str,
        context_query: QuerySpec | None,
        ignore_context: bool,
    ) -> int:
        if cmd == "show-resolved":
            self.render_resolved_tty(selected)
            return 0

        if len(selected) == 1 and cmd != "show-projects":
            self.render_task_detail(selected[0], context_query, ignore_context)
            return 0

        header = "\x1b[4;38;5;250;48;5;232mID  Priority  Tags     Due     Project  Summary     \x1b[0m"
        self._write(header)
        for index, task in enumerate(selected):
            self._write(render_task_row(task, index))
        self._write("")
        self._write(f"{len(selected)} tasks.")
        return 0

    def render_task_detail(self, task: Task, context_query: QuerySpec | None, ignore_context: bool) -> None:
        lines = [
            "\x1b[4;38;5;250;48;5;232mName      Value                                  \x1b[0m",
            render_detail_line("ID", str(task.id)),
            render_detail_line("Priority", task.priority),
            render_detail_line("Summary", task.summary),
            render_detail_line("Status", task.status),
            render_detail_line("Project", task.project),
            render_detail_line("Tags", " ".join(task.tags)),
            render_detail_line("UUID", task.uuid),
            render_detail_line("Created", human_timestamp(task.created)),
        ]
        if task.due != ZERO_TIME:
            lines.append(render_detail_line("Due", human_timestamp(task.due)))
        for line in lines:
            self._write(line)

        if not ignore_context:
            critical_count = self.critical_tasks_outside_current_view(task.uuid, context_query)
            if critical_count > 0:
                noun = "task(s)"
                self._write(f"\x1b[38;5;160m{critical_count} critical {noun} outside this context! Use `dstask -- P0` to see them.\x1b[0m")

    def critical_tasks_outside_current_view(self, task_uuid: str, context_query: QuerySpec | None) -> int:
        tasks = self.load_tasks()
        current_context = self.current_context()
        active_query = parse_query(current_context.split()) if current_context else None
        visible = self.select_tasks(tasks, [], QuerySpec([], [], None, None, None, None, []), active_query, False, OPEN_STATUSES)
        visible_ids = {task.uuid for task in visible}
        total_critical = [task for task in tasks if task.status in OPEN_STATUSES and task.priority == "P0" and task.uuid not in visible_ids]
        if task_uuid in {task.uuid for task in total_critical}:
            return 0
        return len(total_critical)

    def render_resolved_tty(self, tasks: list[Task]) -> None:
        current_bucket = None
        for index, task in enumerate(tasks):
            bucket = resolved_bucket(task.resolved)
            if bucket != current_bucket:
                if current_bucket is not None:
                    self._write("")
                current_bucket = bucket
                self._write("")
                self._write("")
                self._write(f"> {bucket}")
                self._write("")
                self._write("\x1b[4;38;5;250;48;5;232mResolved  Priority  Tags  Due  Project  Summary                      \x1b[0m")
            bg = "233" if index % 2 == 0 else "232"
            resolved_label = human_resolved_short(task.resolved)
            tags = " ".join(task.tags)
            due = human_due_short(task.due)
            note_suffix = ""
            if task.notes.strip():
                note_suffix = f"\x1b[38;5;240m {task.notes.strip()}  \x1b[38;5;166m"
            self._write(
                f"\x1b[0;38;5;166;48;5;{bg}m{resolved_label:<10}{task.priority:<10}{tags:<6}{due:<5} {task.project:<9}{task.summary}{note_suffix}\x1b[0m"
            )
        self._write(f"{len(tasks)} tasks.")

    def select_tasks(
        self,
        tasks: list[Task],
        ids: list[int],
        query: QuerySpec,
        context_query: QuerySpec | None,
        ignore_context: bool,
        statuses: tuple[str, ...],
    ) -> list[Task]:
        selected: list[Task] = []
        for task in tasks:
            if task.status not in statuses:
                continue
            if not ignore_context and context_query and not matches_query(task, context_query):
                continue
            if ids and task.id not in ids:
                continue
            if not matches_query(task, query):
                continue
            selected.append(task)
        return selected

    def _select_single(
        self,
        tasks: list[Task],
        ids: list[int],
        query: QuerySpec,
        context_query: QuerySpec | None,
        ignore_context: bool,
        statuses: tuple[str, ...],
    ) -> Task | None:
        selected = self.select_tasks(tasks, ids, query, context_query, ignore_context, statuses)
        return selected[0] if selected else None

    def _template_task(self, tasks: list[Task], template_id: int | None) -> Task | None:
        if template_id is None:
            return None
        return self._select_single(
            tasks,
            [template_id],
            QuerySpec([], [], None, None, None, None, []),
            None,
            True,
            NON_RESOLVED_STATUSES + ("resolved",),
        )

    def no_matches(self) -> int:
        if self.stdout_is_tty:
            self._error("No matching tasks in given context or filter.")
        else:
            self._write("[]\n")
        return 1 if self.stdout_is_tty else 0

    def _write(self, text: str, newline: bool = True) -> None:
        if newline:
            sys.stdout.write(text + "\n")
        else:
            sys.stdout.write(text)
        sys.stdout.flush()

    def _error(self, text: str) -> None:
        sys.stdout.write(f"{COLOR_RED}{text}{COLOR_RESET}\n")
        sys.stdout.flush()

    def _write_active_context(self, context_string: str, ignore_context: bool) -> None:
        if context_string and not ignore_context:
            self._write(f"{COLOR_YELLOW}Active context: {context_string}{COLOR_RESET}")


def parse_query(tokens: list[str]) -> QuerySpec:
    required_tags: list[str] = []
    excluded_tags: list[str] = []
    project = None
    excluded_project = None
    priority = None
    due = None
    text_terms: list[str] = []
    for token in tokens:
        if token in PRIORITIES:
            priority = token
        elif token.startswith("project:"):
            project = token.split(":", 1)[1]
        elif token.startswith("-project:"):
            excluded_project = token.split(":", 1)[1]
        elif token.startswith("due:"):
            due = parse_due_value(token.split(":", 1)[1])
        elif token.startswith("+") and len(token) > 1:
            required_tags.append(token[1:])
        elif token.startswith("-") and token != "--":
            excluded_tags.append(token[1:])
        elif token:
            text_terms.append(token.lower())
    return QuerySpec(required_tags, excluded_tags, project, excluded_project, priority, due, text_terms)


def parse_task_spec(tokens: list[str]) -> TaskSpec:
    summary_tokens: list[str] = []
    note_tokens: list[str] = []
    add_tags: list[str] = []
    remove_tags: list[str] = []
    project = None
    priority = None
    due = None
    template_id = None
    notes_mode = False
    for token in tokens:
        if token == "/":
            notes_mode = True
            continue
        if notes_mode:
            note_tokens.append(token)
            continue
        if token.startswith("template:"):
            suffix = token.split(":", 1)[1]
            if suffix.isdigit():
                template_id = int(suffix)
            continue
        if token in PRIORITIES:
            priority = token
            continue
        if token.startswith("project:"):
            project = token.split(":", 1)[1]
            continue
        if token.startswith("due:"):
            due = parse_due_value(token.split(":", 1)[1])
            continue
        if token.startswith("+") and len(token) > 1:
            add_tags.append(token[1:])
            continue
        if token.startswith("-") and token != "--":
            remove_tags.append(token[1:])
            continue
        summary_tokens.append(token)
    return TaskSpec(" ".join(summary_tokens).strip(), " ".join(note_tokens).strip(), add_tags, remove_tags, project, priority, due, template_id)


def parse_modify_spec(tokens: list[str]) -> ModifySpec:
    add_tags: list[str] = []
    remove_tags: list[str] = []
    project = None
    clear_project = False
    priority = None
    due = None
    clear_due = False
    for token in tokens:
        if token in PRIORITIES:
            priority = token
        elif token == "project:":
            clear_project = True
        elif token.startswith("project:"):
            project = token.split(":", 1)[1]
        elif token == "due:":
            clear_due = True
        elif token.startswith("due:"):
            due = parse_due_value(token.split(":", 1)[1])
        elif token.startswith("-project:"):
            clear_project = True
        elif token.startswith("+") and len(token) > 1:
            add_tags.append(token[1:])
        elif token.startswith("-") and token != "--":
            remove_tags.append(token[1:])
    return ModifySpec(add_tags, remove_tags, project, clear_project, priority, due, clear_due)


def build_task_from_spec(
    existing_tasks: list[Task],
    spec: TaskSpec,
    template_task: Task | None,
    status: str,
    context_string: str,
) -> Task:
    context_query = parse_query(context_string.split()) if context_string else QuerySpec([], [], None, None, None, None, [])
    template = template_task or Task("", "", "", "", [], "", "P2", ZERO_TIME, ZERO_TIME, ZERO_TIME, 0)
    summary = spec.summary or template.summary
    tags = list(template.tags)
    project = template.project
    priority = template.priority or "P2"
    due = template.due if template.due != ZERO_TIME else ZERO_TIME
    notes = spec.notes or template.notes

    if context_string:
        tags = apply_tag_changes(tags, context_query.required_tags, [])
        if context_query.project is not None:
            project = context_query.project
    tags = apply_tag_changes(tags, spec.add_tags, spec.remove_tags)
    if spec.project is not None:
        project = spec.project
    if spec.priority is not None:
        priority = spec.priority
    if spec.due is not None:
        due = spec.due

    app = DstaskApp.__new__(DstaskApp)
    task_id = DstaskApp.next_id(app, existing_tasks)
    created = now_rfc3339nano()
    resolved = ZERO_TIME if status != "resolved" else now_rfc3339nano()
    if status == "resolved":
        task_id = 0
    return Task(
        uuid=str(uuidlib.uuid4()),
        status=status,
        summary=summary,
        notes=notes,
        tags=tags,
        project=project,
        priority=priority,
        created=created,
        resolved=resolved,
        due=due,
        id=task_id,
    )


def apply_tag_changes(existing: list[str], add_tags: list[str], remove_tags: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    tags = [tag for tag in existing if tag not in remove_tags]
    for tag in add_tags:
        if tag not in tags:
            tags.append(tag)
    return tags


def extract_ids(tokens: list[str]) -> tuple[list[int], list[str]]:
    ids: list[int] = []
    remainder: list[str] = []
    for token in tokens:
        if token.isdigit():
            ids.append(int(token))
        else:
            remainder.append(token)
    return ids, remainder


def extract_first_id(tokens: list[str]) -> tuple[int | None, list[str]]:
    for index, token in enumerate(tokens):
        if token.isdigit():
            remainder = tokens[:index] + tokens[index + 1 :]
            return int(token), remainder
    return None, tokens


def matches_query(task: Task, query: QuerySpec) -> bool:
    if query.project is not None and task.project != query.project:
        return False
    if query.excluded_project is not None and task.project == query.excluded_project:
        return False
    if query.priority is not None and task.priority != query.priority:
        return False
    if query.due is not None and task.due != query.due:
        return False
    task_tags = set(task.tags)
    if any(tag not in task_tags for tag in query.required_tags):
        return False
    if any(tag in task_tags for tag in query.excluded_tags):
        return False
    haystack = " ".join(part for part in [task.summary, task.notes, task.uuid] if part).lower()
    if any(term not in haystack for term in query.text_terms):
        return False
    return True


def now_rfc3339nano() -> str:
    now_ns = time.time_ns()
    seconds, nanos = divmod(now_ns, 1_000_000_000)
    dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(seconds, tz=timezone.utc)
    fraction = f"{nanos:09d}".rstrip("0")
    if fraction:
        return dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S") + "." + fraction + "Z"
    return dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")


def parse_due_value(value: str) -> str:
    value = value.strip()
    if not value:
        return ZERO_TIME
    dt = datetime.strptime(value, "%Y-%m-%d").replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    return dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT00:00:00Z")


def parse_timestamp(value: str) -> datetime | None:
    if not value or value == ZERO_TIME:
        return None
    match = RFC3339_RE.match(value)
    if match is None:
        if value.endswith("Z"):
            value = value[:-1] + "+00:00"
        return datetime.fromisoformat(value)
    year_month_day, hour_minute_second, fraction = match.groups()
    microseconds = 0
    if fraction:
        microseconds = int((fraction + "000000")[:6])
    dt = datetime.strptime(
        f"{year_month_day}T{hour_minute_second}",
        "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S",
    )
    return dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc, microsecond=microseconds)


def format_fraction(dt: datetime | None) -> str:
    if dt is None:
        return ""
    if dt.microsecond == 0:
        return ""
    return f".{dt.microsecond:06d}".rstrip("0")


def human_timestamp(value: str) -> str:
    dt = parse_timestamp(value)
    if dt is None:
        return ""
    match = RFC3339_RE.match(value)
    fraction = ""
    if match is not None and match.group(3):
        fraction = "." + match.group(3)
    return dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") + fraction + " +0000 UTC"


def human_due_short(value: str) -> str:
    dt = parse_timestamp(value)
    if dt is None:
        return ""
    return f"{dt.strftime('%a')} {dt.day}"


def human_project_created(value: str) -> str:
    dt = parse_timestamp(value)
    if dt is None:
        return ""
    return f"{dt.strftime('%a')} {dt.day} {dt.strftime('%b %Y')}"


def human_resolved_short(value: str) -> str:
    dt = parse_timestamp(value)
    if dt is None:
        return ""
    return f"{dt.strftime('%a')} {dt.day}"


def resolved_bucket(value: str) -> str:
    dt = parse_timestamp(value)
    if dt is None:
        return "Week 0, starting Mon 1 Jan 0001"
    week_number = dt.isocalendar().week
    return f"Week {week_number}, starting {dt.strftime('%a')} {dt.day} {dt.strftime('%b %Y')}"


def render_detail_line(name: str, value: str) -> str:
    palette = ["233", "232"]
    index = 0 if name in {"ID", "Summary", "Project", "UUID", "Due"} else 1
    return f"\x1b[0;38;5;250;48;5;{palette[index]}m{name:<10}{value:<39}\x1b[0m"


def render_task_row(task: Task, index: int) -> str:
    bg = "233" if index % 2 == 0 else "232"
    if task.status == "active":
        bg = "250"
    elif task.status == "paused":
        bg = "236"
    fg = {
        "P0": "160" if task.status != "active" else "124",
        "P1": "166" if task.status != "active" else "130",
        "P2": "250",
        "P3": "245",
    }.get(task.priority, "250")
    tags = " ".join(task.tags)
    due = human_due_short(task.due)
    return f"\x1b[0;38;5;{fg};48;5;{bg}m{task.id:<4}{task.priority:<10}{tags:<9}{due:<8}{task.project:<9}{task.summary:<13}\x1b[0m"


def sort_non_resolved(tasks: Iterable[Task]) -> list[Task]:
    return sorted(tasks, key=lambda task: (PRIORITY_ORDER.get(task.priority, 2), ts_key(task.created), task.summary.lower(), task.uuid))


def sort_resolved(tasks: Iterable[Task]) -> list[Task]:
    return sorted(tasks, key=lambda task: (ts_key(task.resolved), ts_key(task.created), task.summary.lower(), task.uuid))


def ts_key(value: str) -> tuple[int, str]:
    return (0, value)


def task_json(task: Task) -> dict[str, object]:
    return {
        "uuid": task.uuid,
        "status": task.status,
        "id": task.id if task.status != "resolved" else 0,
        "summary": task.summary,
        "notes": task.notes,
        "tags": task.tags,
        "project": task.project,
        "priority": task.priority,
        "created": task.created,
        "resolved": task.resolved,
        "due": task.due,
    }


def main() -> int:
    return DstaskApp().run(sys.argv[1:])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
